summary.headline: Arvind SmartSpaces Q1 FY27 presales rose 147% YoY to INR432 crores; PAT jumped to INR97 crores on Orchards Phase 1 BU receipt.
summary.overview: Presales of INR432 crores grew 147% YoY, with management attributing it to both Aqua City demand and broader core-market strength. Revenue rose to INR318 crores from INR102 crores and adjusted EBITDA to INR150 crores from INR25 crores, mainly from Orchards Phase 1 in Bengaluru receiving BU. Collections grew 76% to INR336 crores and net operating cash flow was INR81 crores. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of 35-40% bookings growth, INR4,000-5,000 crores BD and 22-25% EBITDA margin on new sales, and India Ratings upgraded the company to AA- (stable).

segments.name: Ahmedabad (Aqua City, horizontal)
segments.commentary: Aqua City named as standout booking performer in Q1; new Vastrapur project planned for launch this year. Management cites leadership in horizontal development in Ahmedabad.

segments.name: Bengaluru
segments.commentary: Orchards Phase 1 BU received, driving the quarter's revenue and profit step-up; Bengaluru stock close to INR3,000 crores. Three launches planned this year, including Sarjapur, which has approvals.

segments.name: Mumbai / MMR
segments.commentary: Mumbai stock of INR4,000 crores-plus GDV; two Goregaon redevelopment-related and BD additions. Goregaon saleable carpet area about 6.7 lakh sq ft, 35-floor-plus, about 4 years to complete; 2 Mumbai launches planned this year.

guidance_outlook: FY27 bookings growth of 35-40% over FY26, implying about INR2,100-2,200 crores (per Q&A).
FY27 business development of INR4,000-5,000 crores GDV; INR2,600 crores already added in Q1; management leaning to upper band.
EBITDA margin on new sales of 22-25%; management says portfolio average about 25%, JD projects at lower end and outright at higher end.
FY27 operating cash flow target of INR400-500 crores (FY26 about INR400 crores).
Launch pipeline of about INR3,000-3,500 crores booking value across 6 projects (Ahmedabad 1, Bengaluru 3, Mumbai 2) this year.
Land outflow for FY27 of about INR600-900 crores (Q&A), with 4-5 year realisation of INR5,100 crores operating cash flow from existing portfolio.
Management did not give revenue guidance; expects strong YoY growth in FY27 revenue but timing depends on OC receipts, some lined up in Q4.
Medium-term 25-30% CAGR target over 4-5 years; comfort debt-to-equity at 1:1.
capex_capacity: Unrecognised revenue of INR3,825 crores to be recognised over about 4 years: plotted projects 2-3 years, high-rise OC in about 4 years.
Existing portfolio operating cash flow of over INR5,100 crores expected over next 4-5 years.
Construction spend ramped up in Q1; management says larger incremental outflow is construction cost.
Goregaon redevelopment: 200-plus units to be handed to existing members; area for members not yet disclosed.
Pen Khopoli project in Mumbai awaiting approvals; company hopes to launch at least 2 of 3 Mumbai projects this year.
demand_pricing: Management says underlying demand is strong; Aqua City plus broader core-market strength drove bookings.
Sustenance sales improved through sales team build-out across 3 cities, channel partner and marketing reach; sustenance may exceed plan.
Price increases expected to moderate after 3-4 years of strong appreciation; company does not underwrite large price hikes.
Bengaluru price uplift giving better margins on some older projects.
Management sees Mumbai, Bengaluru and Ahmedabad each delivering 22-25% EBITDA; no Tier 2 plans for now.
Management sees annual residential absorption of INR3-4 lakh crores across the three focus markets.

qa_highlights.question: Is Aqua City-driven booking strength project-specific or indicative of underlying demand in Gujarat and Bengaluru?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is a combination of both; the market is strong and stable and responding well to most projects, and underlying demand remains quite strong.

qa_highlights.question: What is the unrecognised revenue conversion and normalised margin outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 margin was boosted by Orchards BU; the 25% portfolio average is the base case. Revenue recognition is OC-linked and lumpy, so no annual revenue guidance is given.

qa_highlights.question: How is OCF flattening and what is FY27 OCF guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: FY26 OCF was about INR400 crores; FY27 target INR400-500 crores. Q1 OCF of INR81 crores reflects higher construction outflow, which management views as positive catch-up.

qa_highlights.question: What is the net debt and leverage comfort level?
qa_highlights.answer: Net debt to equity at 0.29x; management comfortable up to 1:1 and expects gradual debt increase, funded by OCF and debt lines.

qa_highlights.question: How will BD of INR600-1,000 crores be funded?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR400 crores from operating cash flow plus debt headroom; BD cash deployment guided at INR600-1,000 crores in the year (land outflow INR600-900 crores per earlier answer).

qa_highlights.question: Is there a plan for an annuity or commercial portfolio?
qa_highlights.answer: Not today; management is considering it after a few years, starting with for-sale assets to test development before holding assets.

risks_watch: Revenue and margin are lumpy and dependent on OC timing, with some OCs lined up in Q4; the Q1 margin of about 48-49% is well above the 25% portfolio average.
Net debt to equity rising from prior level to 0.29x as BD accelerates; management's comfort threshold is 1:1.
Launch execution: 6 launches worth INR3,000-3,500 crores this year depend on approvals, including Pen Khopoli.
Labour and construction cost inflation is gradual per management but may pressure margins.
Guidance inconsistency: BD cash deployment quoted as INR600-900 crores in one answer and INR600-1,000 crores in another.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on demand and bookings, with explicit reiteration of FY27 guidance; more cautious and deliberately non-committal on revenue recognition timing and annual collections guidance.

financial_highlights.value: about 48-49% (as cited by analyst in Q&A)

financial_highlights.change: up from prior level, company comfort 1:1

key_quotes: We have started the year with a very strong Q1 with presales of INR432 crores, which is a 147% growth year-on-year.
The significant growth in the financial numbers is majorly driven by the BU received for Phase 1 of Orchards project in Bengaluru.
But at the same time, probably factor in a 25% EBITDA at this particular stage as a company average.
So we have taken those assumptions and basis that concluded and estimated this INR5,100 crores of future cash flow.
So we have said also in the past, and we are maintaining our comfort at 1:1 debt equity.
